2608.12932.title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
2608.12932.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise to bring end-to-end reasoning to autonomous driving, but their computational cost remains far too high for real-time control. The core challenge is structural: VLA inference is not a single bottleneck but a cascade of four. Visual encoding wastes compute on overlapping video frames; language-model prefill recomputes context that could be carried over from the previous timestep; reasoning tokens are generated serially despite low entropy; and flow-matching denoising applies uniform compute to a non-uniform velocity field. Addressing any one stage in isolation leaves the others untouched. We propose FlashDrive, an algorithm-system co-design framework that targets all four stages simultaneously. Our key insight is that each bottleneck admits a distinct, lightweight algorithmic shortcut: temporal overlap enables streaming KV-cache reuse across frames; the low per-token entropy and strong intra-block correlations of driving-domain reasoning make a non-autoregressive diffusion drafter highly effective for speculative decoding; and the velocity field's structure---sharp at the endpoints, flat in the middle---permits adaptive step caching that concentrates compute where it matters. Layered on system-level CUDA Graph compilation and kernel fusion, these techniques compound. Applied to Alpamayo 1.5-10B with W4A8 quantization, FlashDrive reduces end-to-end latency from 717ms to 151ms (4.7x) while leaving accuracy essentially unchanged: minADE6@6.4s shifts by only 0.08m, minADE1 improves, and closed-loop collision and off-road rates improve in simulation. By raising a 10B-parameter reasoning VLA from 1.4~Hz to 6.6~Hz on a single GPU, FlashDrive moves end-to-end autonomous driving substantially closer to real-time deployment.
2608.12932.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 模型承諾為自動駕駛帶來端到端的推理，但其計算成本對於實時控制仍然過高。核心挑戰在於結構性：VLA 推理不是單一瓶頸，而是一系列四個瓶頸。視覺編碼在重疊的視頻幀上浪費計算；語言模型預填充重新計算可以從前一時間步驟中攜帶的上下文；推理標記儘管熵低卻是串行生成的；而流匹配去噪則對非均勻速度場應用均勻計算。單獨解決任何一個階段會使其他階段保持不變。我們提出了 FlashDrive，一個針對所有四個階段同時進行的算法-系統共同設計框架。我們的關鍵見解是，每個瓶頸都有一個獨特的輕量級算法捷徑：時間重疊使得在幀之間可以重用流式 KV 緩存；駕駛領域推理的每個標記低熵和強內部區塊相關性使得非自回歸擴散草擬器在推測解碼中非常有效；而速度場的結構——在端點尖銳，中間平坦——允許自適應步驟緩存，將計算集中在重要的地方。這些技術在系統級的 CUDA 圖編譯和內核融合上進行疊加，效果相乘。應用於 Alpamayo 1.5-10B 並使用 W4A8 量化，FlashDrive 將端到端延遲從 717 毫秒降低到 151 毫秒 (4.7 倍)，同時準確性基本保持不變：minADE6@6.4s 僅變化 0.08 米，minADE1 改善，並且在模擬中閉環碰撞和越野率均有所改善。通過將 10B 參數的推理 VLA 從 1.4~Hz 提升到 6.6~Hz，在單個 GPU 上，FlashDrive 使端到端自動駕駛實質上更接近實時部署。
